n8523e9ce12.headline: Oil price outlook weakens on OPEC+ hikes, lingering trade concerns
n8523e9ce12.summary: Analysts have cut oil price forecasts for a third straight month. Swelling OPEC+ supply and uncertainty over trade disputes' effect on fuel demand are weighing on the outlook.
n8523e9ce12.why: Brent is the main global crude benchmark, and OPEC+ output decisions and demand expectations are key drivers of energy prices, inflation and producer earnings.

nacd0606dd4.headline: SEPI could grant Talgo €120m convertible loan to unblock Basque consortium's entry in capital
nacd0606dd4.summary: According to press reports, Spain's state industrial holding SEPI could grant Talgo a convertible loan to unblock the entry of a Basque consortium into its capital. The loan amount is €120m.
nacd0606dd4.why: Talgo is a Spanish rail manufacturer, and state-backed financing and shareholder changes affect its capital structure and strategic direction.

n2f1631e0dd.headline: GOP Lawmakers Urge Elimination of Tax Credits for Geothermal Programs
n2f1631e0dd.summary: A bill moving through the House aims to repeal federal tax credits for clean energy, including geothermal power.
n2f1631e0dd.why: Federal tax credits lower the cost of renewable projects, so repealing them affects project economics and investment in clean energy.

n4339709b9b.headline: China shifts supply chains away from Kansas
n4339709b9b.summary: The U.S. Court of International Trade briefly blocked President Donald Trump from imposing certain tariffs under an emergency powers law. A report said China is shifting supply chains away from Kansas.
n4339709b9b.why: Tariffs and supply chain relocation directly affect import costs, manufacturing location decisions and trade flows.

n94e4718617.headline: Enel to boost US renewables fleet with 285MW wind swap deal
n94e4718617.summary: Enel plans to expand its US renewable energy fleet through a 285 megawatt wind swap deal. The deal was reported by Windpower Monthly.
n94e4718617.why: Enel is an Italian utility with a large global renewables portfolio, and its asset deals shape clean power capacity and earnings.

nea55717866.headline: Kenya inflation slows to 3.8% year-on-year in May
nea55717866.summary: Kenya's annual inflation fell to 3.8% in May from 4.1% a month earlier, the statistics office said. Month-on-month inflation rose to 0.5% from 0.3%.
nea55717866.why: Inflation data shapes the Central Bank of Kenya's interest rate decisions, which affect the shilling, bond yields and borrowing costs.

nb95216522f.headline: "Car prices will shoot up": KRA raises tax schedule for imported used cars
nb95216522f.summary: The Kenya Revenue Authority said a new tax schedule for imported used cars takes effect July 1, 2025, following stakeholder engagement. The change is expected to raise car prices.
nb95216522f.why: Import duties and excise taxes on vehicles affect car prices, dealer margins and consumer demand in Kenya's vehicle import market.

n71a8f99f52.headline: Cedi Gains May Be Temporary Without Reforms – APL
n71a8f99f52.summary: Africa Policy Lens warned that the appreciation of Ghana's cedi could be short-lived without deeper structural reforms. The think tank made the call in a published statement.
n71a8f99f52.why: Currency strength affects import costs, inflation and foreign investor returns in emerging markets. Structural reforms are often needed to sustain currency gains.

n7b30ca6bd2.headline: Special FD interest rate up to 7.8%: IDBI Bank revises FD rates across special deposits, check Utsav FD deadline
n7b30ca6bd2.summary: IDBI Bank is revising interest rates on fixed deposits, the Utsav FD scheme and savings accounts, effective May 16, 2025. Special deposits offer rates up to 7.8%, with higher returns for senior citizens.
n7b30ca6bd2.why: IDBI Bank is an Indian lender, and deposit rate changes affect its funding costs and margins as well as retail savings flows.

n632307cef1.headline: House sales ‘plunge’ in April as stamp duty deadline ends buyer stampede
n632307cef1.summary: UK house sales fell to 64,680 in April from 177,440 in March, according to HMRC estimates. The drop followed the end of the stamp duty deadline that had driven a buyer rush.
n632307cef1.why: Housing transactions reflect consumer confidence and tax policy, and they feed into construction, mortgage lending and property-linked sectors.

nc4a73d6c00.headline: Iron ore pessimism subsides despite looming Simandou supply
nc4a73d6c00.summary: Analysts and traders cut their 2025 iron ore oversupply forecasts to 20-30 million tons from 50 million. Looming supply from Guinea's Simandou project remains a long-term downside risk.
nc4a73d6c00.why: Iron ore is the main raw material for steelmaking, and its price is closely tied to China's steel output and to major miners such as Rio Tinto and BHP.

n4a699f26f3.headline: Sidi Tah Of Mauritania Elected President Of AfDB
n4a699f26f3.summary: Sidi Ould Tah of Mauritania was elected President of the African Development Bank Group at the bank's Annual Meetings in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire.
n4a699f26f3.why: The African Development Bank is a multilateral lender that finances infrastructure and development projects across Africa, and its leadership shapes that lending agenda.

n209bc2efc1.headline: VivoPower Announces XRP-Focused Digital Asset Treasury Strategy and US$121 Million Private Placement Priced at US$6.05 Per Share, Above Last Market Closing Price Under NASDAQ Rules
n209bc2efc1.summary: VivoPower International announced an XRP-focused digital asset treasury strategy and a US$121 million private placement priced at US$6.05 per share, above the last market close.
n209bc2efc1.why: Digital asset treasury companies hold cryptocurrency on their balance sheets, linking corporate equity financing to token prices.

n24e986e64b.headline: Regeneron shares slide on mixed trial data for smoker
n24e986e64b.summary: Regeneron shares fell nearly 18% on Friday after its experimental drug for patients with a type of lung condition commonly called smoker's lung showed mixed trial data.
n24e986e64b.why: Regeneron is a US biotechnology company whose pipeline results, especially for experimental drugs, strongly influence its valuation.
n24e986e64b.why_moved: Mixed trial data for the experimental drug in a smoker's lung condition prompted a sharp sell-off in the shares.

n9e5eb4b7e6.headline: S&P 500 ends near flat but posts biggest monthly pct gain since November 2023
n9e5eb4b7e6.summary: The S&P 500 ended a volatile Friday session little changed as Trump criticised China and then sounded upbeat about reaching a trade deal. The index still posted its biggest monthly percentage gain since November 2023.
n9e5eb4b7e6.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark index of 500 large US-listed companies and is widely used as a gauge of US equity market performance.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The index closed near flat after trade-related comments from Trump, and it posted its biggest monthly gain since late 2023.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n9e5eb4b7e6.why_moved: Trump's comments on China and his upbeat remarks on a possible trade deal produced a volatile session that ended little changed. The index's monthly gain reflects the wider rally over the month.

n4405755248.headline: Tinubu Caps Oil Sector Tax Credits at 20% in New Executive Order
n4405755248.summary: President Tinubu's executive order caps tax credits for oil firms at 20%. The government aims to attract investment and boost revenue.
n4405755248.why: Oil is Nigeria's main export and a major source of government revenue, so changes to tax credits affect upstream investment decisions by oil companies.

ne1005effef.headline: Reform backs cryptocurrency tax cut as party receives first Bitcoin donations
ne1005effef.summary: Reform UK chairman Zia Yusuf suggested a cryptocurrency tax cut could generate up to £1 billion for the Treasury over a decade. The party also received its first Bitcoin donations.
ne1005effef.why: Crypto tax treatment affects investor participation and government revenue, and UK policy on digital assets influences the regulatory outlook for the sector.

nd34fe427f6.headline: M&G rallies on 15% Dai-ichi Life stake and strategic alliance - Invezz
nd34fe427f6.summary: M&G shares rallied on news of a 15% stake held by Dai-ichi Life and a strategic alliance between the two companies.
nd34fe427f6.why: M&G is a UK asset manager and insurer, and Dai-ichi Life is a major Japanese life insurer. Stake changes and alliances can alter a company's ownership and strategic direction.
nd34fe427f6.why_moved: M&G shares rallied after the announcement of a 15% Dai-ichi Life stake and a strategic alliance.

n01e8232a83.headline: India's GDP growth slows to 6.5% in FY25, January-March quarter growth at 7.4%—below FY24 levels | Mint
n01e8232a83.summary: India's annual GDP growth slowed to 6.5% in FY25, slightly above the 6.3% market expectation. A stronger January-March quarter, at 7.4%, helped the figure but it remained below FY24 levels.
n01e8232a83.why: India is one of the world's fastest-growing large economies, so its GDP pace shapes emerging-market allocations and the outlook for the rupee and Indian equities.

nfa37b4c7a3.headline: Tinubu signs Executive Order introducing performance-based tax incentives to attract investors in oil and gas sector
nfa37b4c7a3.summary: President Bola Ahmed Tinubu signed an executive order introducing performance-based tax incentives in Nigeria's oil and gas sector. The order aims to reduce project costs, boost investment and increase revenue.
nfa37b4c7a3.why: Nigeria is Africa's largest oil producer, and its fiscal terms for upstream projects shape foreign investment decisions. Tax incentives directly affect project economics for operators.

n906d4b2e09.headline: Greek shipping: Generates over $40 billion in Annual revenue, $14 Billion of which returns to the Greek economy
n906d4b2e09.summary: Greek shipping generates more than $40 billion in annual revenue, of which about $14 billion returns to the Greek economy, according to the report.
n906d4b2e09.why: Greece has one of the world's largest merchant fleets, and shipping is a major source of foreign income and employment for the country.

n9770ed9b96.headline: Federal Stimulus Update 2025: What’s Being Proposed in Washington
n9770ed9b96.summary: Lawmakers are discussing whether a new federal stimulus will arrive in 2025, with current proposals and timing under debate.
n9770ed9b96.why: Federal stimulus spending affects government deficits, Treasury issuance and consumer demand, all of which matter for US rates and equities.

n6a7a55898b.headline: Texas' $8.5B school funding plan is headed to Abbott's desk. What it means for students and teachers
n6a7a55898b.summary: House Bill 2, which provides $8.5 billion in additional funding for Texas public schools, has passed both chambers and awaits Governor Greg Abbott's signature. It was one of the most debated bills of the 2025 session.
n6a7a55898b.why: State education funding shapes public spending priorities and the fiscal outlook for Texas, one of the largest US state economies.

n19b40e01b9.headline: Nigeria's Dangote oil refinery extends WTI buying spree into July
n19b40e01b9.summary: Nigeria's Dangote refinery will import at least five million barrels of U.S. WTI crude in July, three trading sources told Reuters. The purchases extend a buying spree after a potential record.
n19b40e01b9.why: Dangote is a large privately owned refinery in Lagos, Nigeria, and its crude purchasing choices shift flows between West African and U.S. crude markets.

impacts.name: WTI crude oil
impacts.why: Sustained import purchases of WTI add demand for U.S. crude barrels.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n79a1aa5aa8.headline: Reeves to unlock £100bn spending on roads & energy to boost left-behind areas
n79a1aa5aa8.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves is set to unlock £100bn of spending on roads and energy. The aim is to boost left-behind areas.
n79a1aa5aa8.why: Government infrastructure spending affects construction, energy and transport companies and the UK fiscal outlook.

nfcb959c010.headline: ‘The Buyer is God’: How Unfair Purchasing Practices Occur ‘With Impunity’ in India’s Garment Industry
nfcb959c010.summary: A survey of nearly 200 manufacturers found 54% had to undercut production costs for one or more contracts. The report describes unfair purchasing practices in India's garment sector.
nfcb959c010.why: Garment manufacturing is a major export industry for India, and buyer pricing terms shape supplier margins and labour conditions.

n16a8762cee.headline: Asian markets close: Nikkei dips 1.22%, Hang Seng -1.2%; Sensex ends 182 pts lower at 81,450
n16a8762cee.summary: The Nikkei fell 1.22%, the Hang Seng dropped 1.2%, and the Sensex ended 182 points lower at 81,450 in Asian trading.
n16a8762cee.why: Asian equity benchmarks reflect regional economic sentiment and influence global investor positioning across emerging and developed markets.

n69027d6dcb.headline: Tokyo core inflation reaches 3.6% in May, highest since Jan 2023; factory output falls
n69027d6dcb.summary: Tokyo core consumer inflation rose to 3.6% in May, its highest since January 2023, while factory output fell, according to the report.
n69027d6dcb.why: Tokyo's core CPI is a leading indicator of national inflation, which influences Bank of Japan policy and yen-denominated asset prices.

n5454fdcbcc.headline: ‘Will not accept repeat of last winter’: Major move unveiled to boost country’s energy
n5454fdcbcc.summary: New Zealand has unveiled changes to hydro generation intended to avoid a repeat of last winter's energy shortfall, expected to power around 6,000 more homes.
n5454fdcbcc.why: Hydro generation dominates New Zealand's electricity supply, so changes to it affect power security and wholesale electricity prices.

n6fba9e2e24.headline: Ringgit closes lower against US dollar amid market uncertainty
n6fba9e2e24.summary: The ringgit closed lower against the US dollar on Friday amid renewed uncertainty after a US federal appeals court granted the White House's request to temporarily pause a ruling that struck down Trump's import tariffs.
n6fba9e2e24.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves reflect shifts in global risk sentiment and trade-policy expectations for export-dependent Asian economies.

n5afaa1256f.headline: Retail trade slumps following Trump tariff shock
n5afaa1256f.summary: A ministerial decision extended the life of a massive gas project despite climate concerns, which the report describes as an endorsement of the gas industry. Roadblocks remain, according to the same report.
n5afaa1256f.why: Woodside Energy is Australia's largest independent oil and gas producer, so project approvals affect its reserves, cash flows and the country's LNG export outlook.

n15c4acf3ac.headline: Scope Ratings to publish its report on Greek economy Friday evening
n15c4acf3ac.summary: Scope Ratings will publish its report on the Greek economy on Friday evening. The report identifies high public debt as Greece's main weakness, limiting the government's room to support the economy in hard times.
n15c4acf3ac.why: Scope Ratings is a European credit rating agency, and its sovereign assessments influence borrowing costs for governments.

nf33110fce2.headline: Spark, Air New Zealand claim NZ’s first 5G private network
nf33110fce2.summary: Spark and Air New Zealand have claimed New Zealand's first 5G private network. Supported by Ericsson, it enables real-time communication in a complex warehouse environment.
nf33110fce2.why: Spark is a major New Zealand telecommunications provider, and private 5G networks are a growing business for enterprise connectivity.

nc71f0aaf1f.headline: Louth TD demands action on price transparency as grocery prices soar
nc71f0aaf1f.summary: Louth TD Ged Nash called for action on price transparency as grocery prices soar, ahead of a Dáil debate on excessive prices.
nc71f0aaf1f.why: Grocery price inflation affects household spending and the wider Irish consumer price outlook.

n3d84f6bd4e.headline: Vedanta, Hindalco to Jindal Steel: Metal stocks melt up to 4% as Trump tariff concerns resurface | Stock Market News
n3d84f6bd4e.summary: Metal stocks sold off on Friday, May 29, with the Nifty Metal index the worst sectoral performer. Concerns over Trump's tariffs and the US-China trade deal kept sentiment subdued.
n3d84f6bd4e.why: Metal producers are sensitive to tariffs and trade flows, since these affect export demand and global commodity prices.
n3d84f6bd4e.why_moved: Metal stocks fell amid renewed concerns over Trump's tariffs and the US-China trade deal, which weighed on sentiment.

ncc53b06dd3.headline: Trump Makes Serious Claim Against China Amid Tariff Truce
ncc53b06dd3.summary: President Donald Trump made a claim about China while the tariff truce between the two countries remains in place. Details of the claim were not included in the source.
ncc53b06dd3.why: The US-China tariff truce affects trade flows between the world's two largest economies and global supply chains.

nb0896f623a.headline: Toss eyes expansion in Australia
nb0896f623a.summary: Viva Republica, operator of mobile financial service Toss, is considering an Australian subsidiary as part of its global expansion push.
nb0896f623a.why: Toss is a leading South Korean fintech app, and its overseas moves show how Korean digital finance firms are growing abroad.

nffd1d49dd4.headline: Equity mutual funds offer up to 19% return in May, sectoral & thematic funds take lead
nffd1d49dd4.summary: Indian equity mutual funds performed well in May, with sectoral and thematic funds leading. Some funds posted negative returns, and healthcare funds declined.
nffd1d49dd4.why: Mutual fund performance reflects how domestic investors are positioned across India's equity sectors and themes.

ne92db803a2.headline: Nvidia discloses more China risks, but CEO Huang praises Trump
ne92db803a2.summary: Nvidia disclosed additional China-related risks. CEO Jensen Huang criticised new US export curbs that stop the company selling its H20 chip for the Chinese market.
ne92db803a2.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, and China has been an important market for its data-center products. Export controls directly affect its revenue outlook.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Export curbs stop Nvidia selling its H20 chip made for the Chinese market.
